name: Oracle HCM
description: Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM is an enterprise human-capital-management suite for workforce records, recruiting, onboarding, payroll, benefits, time, talent, performance, compensation, learning, journeys, and HR operations. Organizations configure roles, data security, flexfields, processes, and regional employment rules around their workforce.
agentUseSummary: Oracle HCM cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its current REST catalog exposes a very large versioned surface for viewing and changing workforce, payroll, recruiting, talent, journey, approval, attachment, and administrative data, with runtime customizations and role-dependent shapes. A customer must supply an exact Oracle Cloud host and service identity with function, aggregate, job, and data-role privileges, but Relay has no approved module, resource, field, population, purpose, or mutation contract for bounded agent tools.

blocked.label: Connect Oracle HCM
blocked.description: No generic multi-tenant Relay application is documented; a customer Oracle Cloud host, licensed features, service identity, authentication standard, job roles, and data roles are required.

blocked.label: Read workforce data
blocked.description: Worker, applicant, candidate, assignment, compensation, payroll, benefit, absence, time, talent, performance, learning, demographic, contact, medical, diversity, document, and other people data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change HCM records or processes
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, hiring, terminating, transferring, paying, evaluating, advancing, enrolling, scheduling, assigning, approving, rejecting, withdrawing, or otherwise changing workforce records or processes is blocked.

blocked.label: Administer or bulk-process Oracle HCM
blocked.description: Roles, privileges, data roles, flexfields, lookups, journeys, templates, rules, reports, HCM Data Loader, HCM Extracts, Atom feeds, files, scheduled jobs, and environment configuration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw Oracle HCM interfaces
blocked.description: Arbitrary REST resources, describe-driven raw calls, runtime sandbox metadata, SOAP, private endpoints, browser automation, password or session capture, bulk extraction, and privilege probing are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Oracle HCM action is enabled without one exact module, resource, field, population, purpose, role, legal basis, effective date, workflow, and tenant security contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Oracle HCM tools are mounted before tenant-specific roles, workforce authority, and employment-compliance controls are approved.

providerSetup.blocker: Oracle's July 2026 HCM REST catalog is a large, customer-hosted and versioned enterprise API rather than one stable account surface. It exposes reads and employment-affecting mutations across workers, recruiting, payroll, benefits, compensation, journeys, approvals, documents, learning, performance, time and administration; some endpoints are limited to approved Marketplace partners. Resource shapes can change with runtime customizations and opt-in features. Authentication may use Basic, SAML or JWT over TLS, while authorization depends on function and aggregate privileges delivered through job roles plus customer data roles. The workers API alone can expose addresses, citizenships, disabilities, ethnicities, national identifiers, passports, religion, visas, assignments and other highly sensitive fields with create, update and delete authority. A generic wrapper would be unbounded, and a fixed wrapper requires an exact customer outcome.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, HR, payroll, legal, privacy, employment-compliance, security, works-council, and customer owners must select one bounded outcome and representative tenant. Freeze modules, API version, resources, fields, nested expansions, populations, countries, purposes, lawful bases, roles, data scopes, effective dates, workflows, operations, approvals, retention, deletion, audit, human oversight, discrimination protections, bulk and event behavior, and incident duties. A tenant administrator must then create a dedicated least-privilege identity using an approved non-human authentication method. Only after that may Relay implement pinned typed wrappers with exact-host binding, strict field selection, bounded pagination, safe-mode approvals for every mutation, redaction, audit, idempotency, and post-disable denial.

evidence.supports: Oracle's current HCM REST guide provides versioned APIs to view and manage data across the Fusion Cloud HCM suite.
Oracle catalogs a broad set of read, create, update, delete, approval, notification, attachment, payroll, recruiting, journey and administrative endpoints, including partner-restricted resources.
Oracle HCM REST authentication supports Basic, SAML bearer or JWT over TLS against the customer's Oracle Cloud server, with feature opt-ins and role-based authorization.
REST access requires appropriate function and aggregate privileges through job roles and a corresponding HCM data role defining data access.
The workers API exposes extensive personal, sensitive and employment child resources and permits creation and update, while bulk and change-detection workflows use separate HCM services.
Oracle secures worker details, sensitive details, PII and employment operations with distinct privileges and data policies capable of GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE and DESCRIBE.
Oracle requires a customer-specific server and versioned HCM resource path and recommends the current 11.13.18.05 API version.
